requiredActions: In src/components/metrics.tsx (MetricCard, variant='priority'): render title and subtitle (priorityMetrics[].variant) on one line, subtitle inline immediately after the title, parenthesized, in the existing muted/caption style (reuse the existing i18n key insights.variant.{code}; no new key). Cards with no variant keep rendering the title alone.

Remove the goal-line div and ProgressBar from the compact/priority card's render path entirely (both the SET and NOT_SET/showGoal branches) -- goal is never shown on this card face regardless of goal.state. Do not remove goal.{state,target,progressPct} from the VM or from anywhere Metric Detail (S-P4-02) reads them -- those are unaffected.

Remove the top-right arrow/nav Icon (token 'arrow-right-up-line') from the card's .head markup. Keep the outer <Link to={href(vm.nav)}> wrapper exactly as-is -- the whole card stays the tap target to Metric Detail, unchanged (AC-P4-01-08).

Move the delta (<DeltaLine>) onto the same row as the value, right-aligned -- reuse the existing .spread utility class pattern already used by the simple variant's value+delta row, rather than inventing new CSS. Update .mcard/.head/.value-block/.foot rules in src/dls-stub/dls.css accordingly for the priority/compact card only; the simple variant (Other Focus Metrics) is unaffected.
Do NOT touch value formatting (formatMoney/formatScalar) as part of this handoff -- value-abbreviation is blocked pending OQ-25 and is explicitly out of scope here.

Add/verify Playwright tests named after AC-P4-01-44 covering both a goal-SET priority card (e.g. TPC) and a showGoal=false card (PTPC): both must render identically now -- title+subtitle one line, no goal line/progress bar, no nav icon, delta on the value's row -- across mobile and desktop.

openQuestions: OQ-25 (blocking, not this handoff's concern): priority metric value abbreviation ("RM 80,000" -> "800K") contradicts an earlier reference mockup (FYP "RM 420K", currency kept) and AC-P4-01-09/D-04 (formatMoney, no abbreviated mode). No VM/formatter change is authorized until product/UX resolves which metrics abbreviate, whether the currency prefix survives, thresholds/rounding, and scope (dashboard-only vs every consumer). This handoff's AC-P4-01-44 (layout only) is independent and not blocked by OQ-25.
